definitions.explanation: The feeling of being shy or embarrassed, shown in a blush, a lowered gaze or hesitant manner. Often viewed as an attractive quality, especially in older writing about young women.

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{恥|は}じらい⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。

examples.english: As if he had forgotten all shyness, he burst into song in front of everyone.
